facts.business: JMJ Fintech Limited is an RBI-registered non-deposit taking NBFC primarily engaged in lending money, providing both secured and unsecured loans predominantly to retail customers.
key_risks: Regulatory restrictions - continuously evolving government regulators may impact operations
Competition from other NBFCs and banks
Deployment of funds in specific projects
Changes in compliance norms and regulations
Contingent liabilities and other legal proceedings
Vulnerability to fluctuations in the stock market due to investments in quoted and unquoted shares
Future changes in regulatory system or enforcement of laws and regulations
